species.summary: Gafrarium pectinatum, also known as Gafrarium tumidum, is a species of the genus Gafrarium in the family of Veneridae, order Veneroida in the bivalve class. They are edible clams.
Lambis millepeda, common name the millipede spider conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.

The Triangles, (Trigonodes hyppasia), also known as semi-looper is a moth formerly of the Noctuidae family. It is largely cosmopolitan, found throughout Borneo, Fiji, India, Sri Lanka, São Tomé and Príncipe, Taiwan, Zimbabwe, Northern Australia, and almost all African countries.

Cepora perimale, the caper gull, is a butterfly in the Pieridae family. It is found on Norfolk Island and in New South Wales, the Northern Territory, Queensland, Victoria, Western Australia, Fiji, Irian Jaya, Maluku, Sulawesi, New Caledonia, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands and Vanuatu.
Cethosia penthesilea, the orange lacewing, is a species of heliconiine butterfly found in Southeast Asia, as well as the Australia's Northern Territory.
Haustellum haustellum is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails. It is the type species of the genus Haustellum Schumacher, 1817.
Hippotion brennus is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from the Moluccas, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands and north-eastern Australia.

The sugarcane looper (Mocis frugalis) is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in several parts of the world, including India, Sri Lanka, West African countries and other Oriental regions. Adult is a fruit-piercer and a major pest throughout the crops.
Oliva carneola, common name the carnelian olive, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Olividae, the olives.
Palmadusta asellus is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Talostolida teres, common name the tapering cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Terebra subulata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Terinos taxiles is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Aplysia oculifera is a species of gastropod belonging to the family Aplysiidae.
Arhopala hercules is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Diminovula margarita is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Ovulidae, the ovulids, cowry allies or false cowries.

Euploea wallacei , is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1860. It is found in the Australasian realm The name honours Alfred Russel Wallace.

Hypolycaena danis, the black and white tit or orchid flash, is a butterfly of the Lycaenidae family. It is found in the Maluku Province in Indonesia as well as the New Guinea region and north-eastern Australia.
Micropechis ikaheca, commonly known as the New Guinea small-eyed snake or Ikaheka snake, is a highly venomous elapid, the only species in the genus Micropechis.

Prooedema is a genus of moths of the Crambidae family. It contains only one species, Prooedema inscisalis, which is found in India, China, Indonesia, the Philippines, Papua New Guinea and Australia, where it has been recorded from the Northern Territory and Queensland.
Prosimnia semperi is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Ovulidae, the ovulids, cowry allies or false cowries.
Badamia exclamationis, commonly known as the brown awl or narrow-winged awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in India, Southeast Asia, Australia, and Oceania.
Cleora repetita is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found from Sundaland to Australia and the Solomon Islands.
Heterocentrotus trigonarius, commonly known as the slate pencil urchin or red slate pencil urchin, is found in the tropical waters of the Indo-Pacific region.
Hypolimnas antilope, the spotted crow eggfly, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found from Malaya to the Philippines, New Guinea and Australia.
Acosmeryx miskinoides is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Papua New Guinea.
Asota eusemioides is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found in Papua New Guinea and Indonesia.
Cyrestis achates is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in south-east Asia.
Delias microsticha is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Walter Rothschild in 1904. It is endemic to New Guinea.

Erysichton lineatus, the hairy line-blue, is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It is the sole species of the genus Erysichton. It was first described by Richard Paget Murray in 1874. It is found in New Guinea and along most of the eastern coast of Australia, from Queensland to New South Wales.
Polyura jupiter is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in Indonesia and surrounding islands.
Stenocatantops angustifrons, the common tropical sharptail, is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Southeast Asia and Oceania.

species.name: Sumpil
species.summary: Subulina octona is a species of small, tropical, air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Subulinidae.
Theretra indistincta is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Queensland, Papua New Guinea, Indonesia and the Bismarck Archipelago.

Cocytia durvillii is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is an uncommon day-flying moth in lowland areas of the Moluccas, Aru, and New Guinea. The species has clear wings bordered with black, with an orange patch at the base of each forewing and long antennae, thicker at the outer end.
Erronea errones, the wandering cowry or erroneous cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Fragum unedo is a species of cockle, a marine bivalve mollusc in the family Cardiidae, commonly known as the Pacific strawberry cockle. It is found in tropical seas in the Indo-Pacific region and the empty shells are prized for use in decorative crafts.
Jamides coritus is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Félix Édouard Guérin-Méneville in 1831. It is found in New Guinea.
Lambis scorpius, common name the scorpion conch or scorpion spider conch, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs....

Neoscona theisi adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1842 oleh Walckenaer.
Polistes stigma is a species of paper wasp from Southeast Asia.
Taenaris catops, the silky owl, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in New Guinea and surrounding islands.
Taenaris dimona is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was first described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Tagiades trebellius is a butterfly in the family Hesperiidae (subfamily Pyrginae).
Telicota colon, commonly known as the pale palm dart or pale-orange darter, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Turbo petholatus, common name the tapestry turban, is a species of sea snail, marine gastropod mollusk in the family Turbinidae.
Urapteroides astheniata is a moth of the Uraniidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, from India, Sri Lanka to Fiji, including New Guinea and the tropical north of Australia.
Aliculastrum cylindricum, (common names: cylindrical atys, cylindrical true bubble, silkworm shell), is a species of gastropods belonging to the family Haminoeidae.
Ambulyx dohertyi is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae first described by Walter Rothschild in 1894.
Ambulyx phalaris is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Papua New Guinea.

Comostola pyrrhogona is a moth of the family Geometridae described by Francis Walker in 1866. It is found in the Indo-Australian tropics from India, Sri Lanka to Taiwan, and east to Vanuatu, New Caledonia, northern Australia and Norfolk Island.

Coscinocera hercules (Hercules moth) is a moth of the family Saturniidae, endemic to New Guinea and northern Australia. It has a wingspan of 27 centimetres (11 in), making it the largest moth found in Australia, and its wings have the largest documented surface area (300 square centimeters) of any living insect.
Daphnis dohertyi is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from Indonesia, New Guinea, the Philippines the Solomon Islands and Torres Strait.
Delias momea is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1836 . It is endemic to Sumatra and Java in the Indomalayan realm.
Eupholus schoenherri is a species of beetle belonging to the family Curculionidae. Eupholus petitii is sometimes included here as a subspecies.

Cribrarula cribraria, the 'Sieve/Tan and White Cowry', is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Ocypode cordimanus is a species of crab in the family Ocypodidae, sometimes called the smooth-handed ghost crab. It is widely distributed in the Indian Ocean and Pacific Ocean.

Terebellum terebellum, common name the Terebellum conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Seraphsidae, the true conchs.

Chalcidica pallescens is a moth in the family Cossidae. It was described by Roepke in 1955. It is found in New Guinea and on the Solomon Islands.

species.summary: The black-headed gull (Chroicocephalus ridibundus) is a small gull that breeds in much of Europe and Asia, and also in coastal eastern Canada. Most of the population is migratory and winters further south, but some birds reside in the milder westernmost areas of Europe.

The north Moluccan cicadabird (Edolisoma grayi) is a passerine bird in the family Campephagidae that is found on Halmahera, the Bacan Islands, the Tukangbesi Islands and the island of Morotai in the northern Moluccas Islands of Indonesia.

Ziridava xylinaria (indistinct carpet) is a moth in the family Geometridae. It is found in Sri Lanka, India, Hong Kong and on Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Java and possibly the Philippines and Sulawesi.
Actinus imperialis is a beetle of the Staphylinidae family, Staphylinidae subfamily.
Agrioglypta deliciosa is a moth in the Crambidae family. It is found on the Solomon Islands, as well as in New Guinea and Australia, where it is found in the tropical far north of Queensland.

Astralium rhodostomum, common name the rosemouth star shell, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Turbinidae, the turban snails.
Aulacophora abdominalis is a species of leaf beetle in the genus Aulacophora.
Blasicrura pallidula, common name the little pallid cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Brachidontes crebristriatus, also known as the Hawaiian mussel, nahawele liʻiliʻi or kio-nawahele, is a bivalve known only from Hawaiʻi.
Bufonaria rana is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Bursidae, the frog shells.
Bursa bufonia, common name the warty frog shell, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Bursidae, the frog shells.

Cerithium nesioticum is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cerithiidae.
Cerithium punctatum is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cerithiidae.
Chicoreus microphyllus, common name the curly murex, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.
Chrysoclystis perornata is a species of moth in the family Geometridae. It is found on New Guinea.

Cirrochroa imperatrix is a species of butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Henley Grose-Smith in 1894. It is found on Biak and Supiori, and is possibly also present on Sulawesi, Indonesia and New Guinea.

Culex sitiens is an insect native to coastal areas of East Africa and Madagascar, southwestern Asia, Ryukyu Archipelago, Korea, northern Australia and South Pacific islands.
Cyana thoracica is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Walter Rothschild and Karl Jordan in 1912. It is found in New Guinea.
Cyme sexualis is a moth of the subfamily Arctiinae first described by Felder in 1864. It is found on Ambon, Sulawesi, the Dampier Archipelago. and in New Guinea.
Dendrelaphis macrops atau ular-tali numfor adalah spesies ular dari famili Colubridae .
Engina lineata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Pisaniidae.

Enigmonia is a genus of saltwater clams, a marine bivalve mollusc in the family Anomiidae, the jingle shells. Enigmonia aenigmatica, the mangrove jingle shell clam, is the only species in this monotypic genus. It is found living on mangroves in the Indo-Pacific Ocean.
Eoacmaea profunda is a species of sea snail, a true limpet, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Eoacmaeidae, one of the families of true limpets.
Euchelus atratus, common name the blackish margarite, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chilodontaidae.

Euploea stephensii is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Australasian realm.

species.summary: Euthaliopsis is a monotypic genus erected by Jacob R. H. Neervoort van de Poll in 1896. The single contained species is Euthaliopsis aetion (Hewitson, 1862) which feeds on Calophyllum as a larva.
Garudinodes bicolorana is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by George Thomas Bethune-Baker in 1908. It is found in Papua New Guinea.
Gasteracantha quadrispinosa, the four-spined jewel spider, is a brightly coloured species of spider in the spiny orb-weaver genus Gasteracantha.
Glyphodes eurygania is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Herbert Druce in 1902. It is found in Papua New Guinea, among other places.
Glyphodes umbria is a moth of the family Crambidae described by George Hampson in 1898. It is known from Fergusson Island of Papua New Guinea.
Gnoma boisduvali is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Plavilstshikov in 1931. It is known from Papua New Guinea.
Graphicomassa ligula is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Columbellidae, the dove snails.
Gutturnium muricinum, common name the knobbly triton, is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cymatiidae.
Hastula albula, common name : the white-banded auger, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Heterallactis phlogozona is a species of moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Australia (the Northern Territory and Queensland) and Papua New Guinea.

Iotyrris cingulifera is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Turridae, the turrids.

Iridomyrmex pallidus is a species of ant in the genus Iridomyrmex. Described by Forel in 1901, the ant is endemic to Australia, New Guinea and the Solomon Islands, and their preferred habitats include tropical rainforests and eucalypt forest.
Julia exquisita is a species of very small sea snail with a shell comprising two separate hinged pieces or valves. It is a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Juliidae.
Leptomyrmex niger is a species of ant in the genus Leptomyrmex. Described by Carlo Emery in 1900, the species is endemic to New Guinea.
Limaria orientalis, common name the file shell, is a bivalve mollusc of the family Limidae, the file shells. It is present in New Zealand.
Lioconcha castrensis, common name the zigzag venus, is a species of saltwater clam, a marine bivalve mollusc in the family Veneridae, the venus clams.
Littoraria pallescens is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Littorinidae, the winkles or periwinkles.
Mammilla simiae is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.
Mansonia (Mansonioides) uniformis is a species of zoophilic mosquito belonging to the genus Mansonia.
Margarosticha papuensis is a species of moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Eugene G. Munroe in 1959. It is found on New Guinea.
Meretrix meretrix, commonly known as the Asiatic hard clam, is a species of saltwater bivalve in the family Veneridae.
Morula uva is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.
Murichorda fiscellum, common name : the little basket drupe, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.
Muricodrupa anaxares is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails. Before 2019, it was classified as Morula anaxares.
Myurella pygmaea, common name the pygmy auger, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Myurellopsis columellaris is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Naria eburnea, common name ivory cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Nassarius arcularia, common name : the casket nassa or the little box dog whelk, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Nassariidae, the Nassa mud snails or dog whelks.
Nassarius papillosus, common name : the pimpled nassa, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Nassariidae, the Nassa mud snails or dog whelks.
Natica stellata is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.
Natica vittellus is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.

Nebularia acuminata (common name: acuminate mitre) is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Mitridae, the miters or miter snails. The shell size varies between 17 mm and 35 mm.
Nebularia eremitarum (common name: adusta mitre) is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Mitridae, the miters or miter snails.
Neoscaptia flavicaput is a moth of the subfamily Arctiinae. It was described by Rothschild in 1912. It is found in New Guinea.
Neripteron violaceum is a species of brackish water snail, an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae, the nerites.

species.summary: Nosophora fulvalis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by George Hampson in 1898. It is found in Papua New Guinea, where it has been recorded from Fergusson Island in the D'Entrecasteaux Islands. It is also found on Borneo and in Australia.
Miniaceoliva miniacea, common name the Pacific common olive, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Olividae, the olives.
Oliva tigridella is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Olividae, the olives.
Oxymeris cerithina is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Oxymeris crenulata, common name crenulate auger, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Oxymeris felina, common name : the Tiger Auger, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Terebridae, the auger snails.
Pachynoa thoosalis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1859. It is found in India, Papua New Guinea and Taiwan.
Pagyda salvalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Francis Walker in 1859. It is found in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka.
Peristernia ustulata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Fasciolariidae, the spindle snails, the tulip snails and their allies.
Phos textus is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Nassariidae.

Patania balteata is a moth of the Crambidae family. It was described by Fabricius in 1798. It is found across southern Europe, Africa and Asia, including Japan, Korea, Réunion, Madagascar, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey and Ukraine, as well as New South Wales and Queensland. There is also an old record from Hawaii.
Polyrhachis illaudata is a species of large ant found in Sri Lanka, India extending through Southeast Asia to the Philippines. The colonies have a single queen and nest within wood.

Reticulana is a monotypic moth genus of the family Erebidae. Its only species, Reticulana costilinea, is found on New Guinea. Both the genus and species were first described by George Thomas Bethune-Baker in 1906.
Reticutriton pfeifferianus is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Cymatiidae.
Rhinoclavis aspera is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cerithiidae.
Rhinoclavis kochi is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cerithiidae.
Rhinoscapha tricolor is a species of true weevil family. It occurs in Papua New Guinea.
Rosenbergia weiskei is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Heller in 1902.
Septa rubecula, common name : the ruby triton or the red redbreast triton, is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cymatiidae.
Syllepte solilucis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by George Hampson in 1898. It is found in Western New Guinea, Indonesia.
Syllepte subaenescens is a moth in the family Crambidae. It is found in Australia, where it has been recorded from Queensland.
Taenaris gorgo is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Theodor Franz Wilhelm Kirsch in 1877. It is endemic to New Guinea in the Australasian realm
Terestrombus terebellatus, common name : the little auger conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.

Toxorhynchites (Toxorhynchites) splendens is a species of non-hematophagous (not blood-feeding) mosquito belonging to the genus Toxorhynchites. It is widely used as a predator to control dengue mosquitoes.
Trochus maculatus, common name the maculated top shell, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Trochidae, the top snails.

Vanikoro cancellata is a species of very small sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Vanikoridae.
